1.title: Early Formation Period
1.summary: In Arknights, Prologue: Evil Time Part 1, the story begins with the Doctor waking up inside a mysterious facility with no memory of their past. They are quickly rescued by Amiya and members of Rhodes Island, a pharmaceutical organization working to combat the deadly disease Oripathy and protect infected people. However, their rescue is interrupted by an attack from Reunion, a violent faction of infected rebels who oppose the existing system and have begun large-scale uprisings. As Rhodes Island tries to extract the Doctor, they are forced into a dangerous escape while fighting off Reunion forces like Crownslayer. Despite heavy resistance and losses, elite operators arrive to support the retreat, allowing Amiya and the team to successfully evacuate the Doctor. The chapter ends by establishing the growing conflict between Rhodes Island and Reunion, and sets the stage for the larger war unfolding in the world.

about.title: About This Website
about.desc: An interactive exploration of history. This website was created to provide an engaging way to learn about Vietnamese history. Each timeline event is represented by a card that can be clicked for more details, and the background features a dynamic 3D visual created with Three.js to enhance the user experience. The side text is a summary of the major event, and clicking the card will reveal more information. Please note that this website may not be fully optimized for mobile devices and is best viewed on a desktop or laptop for the full experience. However, we are continuously working on improving the design and functionality to make it more accessible for all users.
